tasks.title: Wind at altitude
tasks.statement: At the weather station (10 m) the wind is **{v} m/s**, open terrain (α = 1/7). What will the mean wind be at **{h} m**?

tasks.title: Density altitude
tasks.statement: A site at **{e} m**, temperature **{tc} °C**. Estimate the density altitude (ISA: 15 °C at sea level, −6.5 °C/km; ≈ 36.6 m for every °C of deviation).
